events.headline: IRAN CLAIMS TO HAVE CAPTURED A US ‘SAIL DRONE’ NEAR HORMUZ STRAIT
events.detail: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says its navy struck a US-operated surface drone at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: IRGC ATTACKS US UNMANNED VESSEL IN HORMUZ; TWO SHIPS HIT
events.detail: IRGC says it attacked a US unmanned vessel in Hormuz, while UKMTO says projectiles hit two ships off Oman.

events.headline: IRAN DESTROYS US SPY SAILDRONE IN HORMUZ (VIDEO)
events.detail: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says it has destroyed a US Saildrone Explorer reconnaissance vessel in the Strait of Hormuz Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: LOS HUTÍES TOMAN EL PUERTO ESTRATÉGICO DE MOCA Y AMENAZAN CON UN DOBLE ESTRANGUL
events.detail: La milicia yemení amenaza con controlar el estrecho de Bab el Mandeb, abriendo la puerta a un doble bloqueo con Ormuz en plena escalada bélica entre EE UU e Irán

events.headline: TRUMP VOWS TO HIT ‘A LOT MORE’ IRANIAN TANKERS
events.detail: President Donald Trump has claimed that the US has already taken out “about nine” Iranian oil tankers and threatened to attack “a lot more” Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: IRAN RETALIATES AFTER US STRIKES ON OIL TANKERS (VIDEOS)
events.detail: Iran says it struck two US vessels and eight oil tankers in retaliation for US attacks on Iranian shipping Read Full Article at RT.com
